hop_glosses: Hop 1 identifies Napoleon via his rise during the French Revolution; hop 2 supplies the coup by which he became First Consul.

sufficient_sets.text: He rose to prominence as a general during the French Revolution and led a series of military campaigns across Europe and the Middle East during the French Revolutionary and Napoleonic Wars.
In November 1799 Napoleon engineered the Coup of 18 Brumaire against the French Directory and became First Consul of the Republic.
